The request feels a bit ambiguous, but I think it should be self-contained, with functions that take arguments and return outputs. I want to design reusable functions and possibly include a command-line interface (CLI) menu. It’s important to implement operations cautiously, so I’ll ensure safety and showcase string operations effectively. Maybe I'll provide an interactive menu that works on two strings and use parameters clearly.**Designing String Operations**

The main function would gather two strings and display a menu. I also need to ensure safety by managing inputs properly, using clear functions while avoiding global variables. Maybe I’ll simplify the menu and implement an interactive loop with proper input handling and prompts.**Implementing String Functions**

The main function would read two strings and demonstrate all operations like printing length, copying, concatenating, and reversing, without needing interactivity. I also need to consider null handling for copy and concatenate operations and ensure capacity constraints are respected. Returning 0 if an operation doesn't fit seems important!
